hook: Koray Kavukcuoglu is a senior vice president at Google DeepMind and Google's Chief AI Architect, according to his LinkedIn profile. He joined DeepMind as a research scientist in 2012 and rose through its research leadership to become chief technology officer in January 2024. He trained in aerospace engineering in Turkey before earning a PhD in computer science at New York University.
